source.title: An experimental data base for the development, calibration and verification of constitutive models for sand with focus to cyclic loading. Part I
source.locator: Table3, PDFp5; caption gives state at initial mean pressure prior to shearing
source.visual_review: coordinator rechecked rendered PDFp5 on2026-11-01; independent scientific review remains pending

file_initial.void_ratio: exact existing normalized-file initial value for all eleven development tests
file_initial.effective_stress: exact normalized-file six-component effective stress; Pa, compression positive

original_table_disputed_e0.effective_stress: unchanged file_initial; do not replace by nominal isotropic pressures
original_table_disputed_e0.meaning: hybrid sensitivity scenario replacing only disputed e0 values, not reproduction of a full original published initialization

initial_state_binding.sigma: file effective_stress in archived model order
initial_state_binding.transient_gamma: zero if explicitly declared transient by the archived definition
initial_state_binding.other_history: not supplied; this policy cannot initialize additional memory variables or admit IGS/SANISAND/Terra Cotta

locked_parameter_evaluation.parameter_selection: existing selected budget96 fits only; unchanged
locked_parameter_evaluation.claim: conditional evaluation-input sensitivity only; cannot propagate uncertainty in TMD13 calibration or validate its original fit

full_scenario_recalibration.status: deferred pending a separate complete prospective numerical freeze
full_scenario_recalibration.calibration_change: density3 TMD13 changes e0; pressure3 states unchanged
must_hold_fixed: optimizer seeds, bounds, budgets and failure handling
full_scenario_recalibration.no_cross_scenario_selection: report every frozen scenario; never select source/e0 or fitted vector by evaluation error

decision.historical_results: retain file initialization and development-only labels; do not relabel as corrected source initialization
decision.physical_source_preference: unresolved; no averaging, voting among secondary publications or inferred correction
decision.uncertainty: two discrete assumptions; not a probability distribution, confidence interval or empirical bound on all admissible initial states
decision.published_baseline: source-matched nominal TMD2+IGS reproduction is a separate qualified case; not interchangeable with this base-VW96 panel
